svg.aria-label: Kubernetes RBAC in Practice overview. A developer uses a kubeconfig file with a short-lived 8h token to call the Kubernetes API server with kubectl. The API server checks RBAC: in the dev namespace a RoleBinding connects the ServiceAccount dev-viewer (who) to the Role pod-reader (what: get, list, and watch on pods and pods/log), so reading the orders Pod and its logs is allowed. Requests to the pro namespace are denied as Forbidden. In production, a RoleBinding gives an OIDC group the built-in view ClusterRole instead.
svg.title: Kubernetes RBAC in Practice: a developer kubeconfig, the API server RBAC check, read access in dev, Forbidden in pro
svg.text: Read Pods and logs in one namespace
